en: Sepia-toned vintage interior photograph of a small shop or café, likely a bakery or confectionery. The room has a wooden floor and a paneled ceiling with a single bare lightbulb hanging from it. Glass display counters along two walls are filled with pastries or sweets, and shelves behind the counters are stocked with tins, boxes, and jars. Several large round hatbox-like containers sit on the top shelves. Three women stand behind the main counter area and a man in a white coat, possibly the proprietor, stands at the rightmost glass case. In the foreground there are tables covered with white cloths and simple wooden chairs, suggesting a place to sit and eat. The print has scalloped edges typical of old postcards or photo prints.
